# XML fact counters (any XML, XSD, XSLT, Spring, Maven): one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex),
# counted over the whole file. The [ignore] line runs first and reads the file as a parser does,
# leftmost region first: it blanks comments, CDATA sections, processing instructions and the DOCTYPE
# with its internal subset (keeping the line breaks), so a commented-out element or the markup of an
# entity does not count and a "<!--" inside CDATA opens nothing. A region that is never closed runs to
# the end of the file, as a parser reads it until it fails there; every pattern stays linear in the
# length of the file, also over unclosed openers and tags. Element and attribute counts are regex
# heuristics over the text, not a parse: a ">" inside an attribute value, or a "]" inside an attribute
# value of the internal subset, is not seen. An id or name attribute counts inside a tag (its "<" up to
# 2,000 characters back, no ">" between), so a "name = 'a'" in element text does not. XmlFactPatternsTest pins every case; pom-facts adds the
# Maven counters.
[ignore] comments, CDATA, processing instructions and the DOCTYPE
elements
